company.shortDescription: Hirebolt uses artificial intelligence to locate actively seeking staffs, assess them, and links them to employers.
company.description:
Hirebolt is an HR platform that uses artificial intelligence to locate actively seeking staffs, assess them, and links them to employers. They arrange interviews and give offers to prospects faster than humans, freeing up time for employers to operate their businesses.

Hirebolt is headquartered in London, England and was founded in 2021.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven platform that identifies actively seeking job candidates, evaluates their qualifications, and connects them with employers in the hospitality sector.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 89 (+52 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
